agents.title: Agents

agents.disableAllBody: Skills installed from the library are removed from every agent's folder. The library itself is not touched, and skills you put there yourself stay.
agents.disableBody_one: {{count}} skill installed from the library is removed from its folder. The library keeps it.
agents.disableBody_other: {{count}} skills installed from the library are removed from its folder. The library keeps them.
agents.removeBody: Skills installed from the library are removed from its folder. Anything else in the folder stays.

custom.title: Add custom agent
custom.description: For an agent {{app}} does not know yet. It only needs a folder to put skills in.
custom.name: Name
custom.projectDirHint: Relative to a project's root. Leave it empty if the agent has no per-project skills.

library.title: Library location
library.description: The folder that holds every skill, the database and the backup history.
library.restartTitle: Restart to move the library to
library.error: Could not change the library location.

deploy.title: How skills are installed
deploy.description: Applies to skills you install from now on; existing ones keep their mode.

symlink.title: Link to the library
symlink.body: Agents read the library's copy, so edits and updates show up everywhere at once. Links inside a project point at this machine's library and will not work for teammates.

copy.title: Copy into the agent
copy.body: Every agent and project gets its own copy that works anywhere, including in repositories you share with a team.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.textSizeHint: Scales all text in the app.

window.title: Window and tray
window.trayHint: Quick access to presets and update checks while the window is closed.

close.title: When the window is closed
close.description: Staying in the tray keeps automatic backups and update checks running.
close.hideNeedsTray: Turn the tray icon on to use this.

network.title: Proxy
network.description: Route {{app}}'s own downloads through a proxy server.
network.hint: Starts with http://, https:// or socks5://. Leave it empty for a direct connection.
network.invalid: The address has to start with http://, https:// or socks5://.

applies.market: Browsing and installing from the marketplace
applies.sources: Downloading and updating skills from Git repositories
applies.updates: Checking for and downloading app updates

network.notApplied: Backup pushes and pulls use your own Git configuration, including any proxy set there.

updates.title: Automatic checks
updates.description: {{app}} compares each skill with the place it was installed from.
updates.applyHint: Updates that would delete files are never installed without asking.

backup.title: Backup options
backup.description: Connecting, syncing and restoring happen on the Backup page.
backup.mergeHint: When two computers changed the library, whole skills are merged instead of text lines, and a skill changed on both is kept for you to decide. Turn this off to use Git's plain line merge.
backup.clientIdHint: The client id of a GitHub OAuth app with device flow enabled. Setting it adds “Sign in with GitHub” to the Backup page; without it you connect with an access token.

cli.title: Command-line tool
cli.description: Everything the app can do with skills, as commands for scripts and agents.
cli.notPublishedHint: The tool could not be put in place on the last start. Restart {{app}} to try again.
cli.pathHint: Use the full location above if the command is not on your PATH. Add --json for output that programs can read.

examples.deploy: Install a skill for one agent

control.title: Teach your agents
control.description: Installs the “{{skill}}” skill, which tells an agent how to list, install and update skills through the command-line tool instead of editing folders by hand.
